log.msg: REGRESSION BAR MET: untitled, all 10 .pg-node rects, x/y/w/h delta 0.00 between the OLD size_decls output and the new one (old strings recomputed in-browser and applied, measured, then restored - restore delta also 0). Four nodes lost a redundant align-self: flex-start beside a cross-axis length with zero effect, which is the audit claim proven live.

Decisions so far: (a) floors are max(authored-or-0px, var(--pg-pad-floor|--pg-gap-floor, 0px)) written INSIDE the inline style, the vars set by two classes on .pg-canvas-body; a shorthand padding (1em 2em) is written verbatim - max() takes lengths only, and a bare 0 is a number not a length so it is normalised to 0px. (b) gap left the shared BOX map: block layout draws none, so a plain Box writes no gap declaration; the data still survives convert(). (c) toggles are NOT persisted - a viewing aid resets on reload like the viewport preset. (d) main-axis fixed keeps flex: 0 0 len rather than a plain width: len - both are ONE declaration, so the tie breaks on behaviour: the shorthand keeps WYSIWYG with the drag commit and keeps untitled at delta 0. The width: len alternative would resolve the parked length-vs-grow collision (readme line 28) but changes the owner document; parked for them.

log.msg: FLOOR TOGGLES PROVEN on a 42-node fixture: floor ON, a padding-0 box computes 3.82px (0.25em) and a gap-0 row separates its children by 3.82px; floor OFF both read 0px. A box that typed 1em reads 15.28px in BOTH states - max() floors, never overrides. Round trip off-then-on: 0 of 42 nodes drifted, both toggles. Toolbar, both rails, canvas and canvas-body never moved in any of the four toggles. Gap OFF moved exactly one node - the second child of the one gap-0 row.

AUDIT MEASURED, 18 cells: 6 now write nothing (flex MAIN hug, flex CROSS fill, grid fill x2, block width fill, block height hug), a 7th writes nothing when the container align is non-stretch, and 3 cells that wrote two declarations write one (align-self beside a cross-axis length was redundant - stretch only applies to an AUTO cross size, proven identical 61.11px). Three deliberate behaviour changes, all measured: (1) hug on the flex main axis now equals never-touched, which costs flex-shrink 1 in an OVERCOMMITTED column only (32.25 -> 30.55px); (2) cross-axis hug under align:center no longer yanks the child to the top (y 576.50 -> 609.03, same 32.25px height) - the old unconditional align-self was wrong; (3) block-context height:fill stopped being a no-op, height:100% (32.25 -> 127.89px in a 9em parent) and still computes to auto when the parent has no height.

SEED: holy grail shipped - page/header/body(nav,main,aside)/footer, bg var(--surface) on the page, height 24em so fill has something to fill, rails 10em/8em, main fill. Five of the seven boxes write NO size declaration, which is the lesson. Also gave .pg-canvas-body background: var(--wash) - a white page on a white canvas is a bg you cannot see. Rails were 12em/10em on the first shot and main came out narrower than both at a 1280 window; narrowed and re-shot.

**What landed** - [the tool](/framework/ext/Playground/) (two new toolbar toggles: `pad`, `gap`) - [the truth table and every measurement](/framework/ext/Playground/doc/decisions/) - [readme](/framework/ext/Playground/readme.md) watch-outs rewritten. Files: `items.js` (`floored()`, audited `size_decls`), `toolbar.js`, `documents.js` (`seed()`), `Playground.js` (floors on at build; `set_viewport` positions handles directly), `playground.css` (`.pg-pad-floor`/`.pg-gap-floor`, `.pg-btn.on`, a `--wash` canvas so a `surface` page reads).

**Three behaviour changes, each measured and defended**: `hug` on the flex main axis now equals never-touched (costs `flex-shrink: 1` in an *overcommitted* column only, 32.25 -> 30.55px); a cross-axis `hug` under `align: center` no longer yanks the child to the top (y 576.50 -> 609.03, same height); block-context `height: fill` stopped being a no-op (`height: 100%`, 32.25 -> 127.89px, still `auto` when the parent has no height).

**Parked for you** - swapping the flex MAIN length to a plain `width: <len>`: same one-declaration cost, and it would end the length-vs-`grow` collision the readme has carried since pg-sidebar, but it changes how `untitled`'s `main` box renders, so it is your call. Floors are deliberately not persisted (a viewing aid, like the viewport preset).
